messages:
Ben (support): FYI Acme Corp reporting intermittent 401s + latency spikes since 2026-03-15 18:00 UTC. Ticket INC-5421. They also asked for ISO27001 evidence: proof of KMS key rotation for their CMK and audit log exports for last 90 days. Can eng + sec help triage? @sec-oncall

Samira (eng): Can you paste a sample request + X-Request-ID and the response headers? 401 pattern usually stale token or routing to an old auth cache entry.

Ben (support): Sample curl + headers: ```curl -i -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-live-xxxx' -H 'X-Request-ID: acme-req-123' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'``` Response sometimes 401, other times 200. Response header snapshot: `x-request-id: acme-req-123`, `x-latency-ms: 2430` (when bad). I exported partial audit logs to S3: https://s3.redwood.internal/acme/exports/acme_audit_export_1978456789.csv?sig=PLACEHOLDER

Liam (eng-runtime): We had a deploy at 2026-03-15 17:55 UTC that touched auth-proxy config. deploy-bot posted the release. Could be related to cache TTLs.

deploy-bot: Deploy succeeded: release/2026-03-15/eng-auth-proxy at 17:55 UTC

Samira (eng): I'll tail auth-proxy for X-Request-ID acme-req-123 and check token validation path. If old keys are accepted, it likely points to cache invalidation.

Priya (security): For ISO27001 mapping we need the following to hand to Acme: KMS key id, rotation events with timestamps, KMS audit log entries (KeyAccess/GenerateDataKey/Decrypt) for their CMK, and a retention-policy mapping doc explaining why 90d was used. Ben, confirm the CMK key id and tenancy.

Ben (support): Customer CMK: `projects/redwood/kms/keys/acme-cmk-987` under acct acme-123. I uploaded a partial export to the S3 link above (will push full export once we confirm window).

sec-oncall: Quick note: keys are in Cloud-KMS (no HSM). Rotation is yearly; last rotation recorded 2025-11-02. I'll pull KMS admin logs and check for any anomalies around 18:00 UTC. We store control-plane logs 365d, request-level API logs 90d by default.

Sophie (support): Customer wants signed proof of rotation and a short timeline. Priya — can we generate a small mapping doc to ISO controls (which controls to cite)?

Priya (security): Yes. I'll draft a mapping: A.10.1 -> cryptographic controls (KMS rotation policy + rotation event), A.12.4/A.12.1 -> logging & monitoring (audit export + retention policy). I'll attach the mapping snippet and cite internal policy (/docs/compliance/iso27001-mapping.md).

Ben (support): Customer repro notes: 1) Create API key; 2) rotate key via console; 3) reuse old key — sometimes returns 401, sometimes 200 with high latency. Sample repro command: `curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer OLD_KEY' -H 'X-Request-ID: acme-repro-001' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"test"}'`

Samira (eng): That aligns with an auth-lookup cache TTL bug. We currently cache key metadata for 120s. If invalidation on rotate failed, old key could be accepted until cache TTL expires. I'll instrument and open a PR to add invalidation hooks on rotate events. Short-term mitigation: reduce cache TTL to 10s on the auth-proxy for a canary.

Liam (eng-runtime): I'll coordinate a canary config change to drop TTL and monitor p50/p95 + error-rate. If latency/401s go down we can roll a hotfix.

Priya (security): For the compliance package we should provide: (1) audit log export (CSV) for requested window, (2) KMS rotation audit entries + key metadata, (3) a signed statement from SecOps confirming key type (Cloud-KMS) and rotation schedule, and (4) a short incident timeline tying the anomaly to cache invalidation + deploy. Ben, can you bundle and send via secure transfer (SFTP or pre-agreed method)?

Ben (support): I'll upload to their SFTP and share manifest + checksums. Target ETA ~3 hours. Tagging @sec-oncall for sign-off on the statement.

sec-oncall: Acknowledged. I'll review the pulled logs and sign the statement if entries match. Recommend we record this as a minor incident and include remediation: add rotation invalidation hooks, shorten TTL temporarily, and add automated tests for key rotation.

Sophie (support): Updated INC-5421 with repro steps, linked S3 export, and notified customer that evidence will be delivered within 4 hours. :white_check_mark:

Ben (support): Thanks all — I'll post the final package once sec-oncall signs off and we confirm the canary.

Samira (eng): Quick note — if anyone needs the auth-proxy trace command: `kubectl logs -f deploy/auth-proxy -c auth | grep acme-req-123`

Priya (security): I'll draft the ISO mapping snippet and include control references + the short remediation statement for the audit packet.

Liam (eng-runtime): I'll watch metrics and post p95 numbers in this thread after canary.

Sophie (support): ping me if you want me to escalate to Account Exec for communication cadence.
